parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm with narrow QRS and no pathologic Q waves or reciprocal changes; the small concave J-point/ST elevation with tall upright T waves in V2–V3 looks like a benign normal variant (early repolarization/high take-off), so it does not meet STEMI criteria, contrary to your impression.
